caption:
Credit reporting is where most complaints land. 📞

The CFPB's 2025 annual report says it got about 5.8 million credit/consumer reporting complaints. That's roughly 88% of the 6.6+ million total.

It's one reason to read your full report now and then.

Have you ever found an error on yours?
first_comment: Have you ever disputed something on your report? How did it go? 👇

card.headline: 88% of CFPB complaints in 2025 were about credit reporting.
card.source: Source: CFPB annual report via PYMNTS
